feeds.title: Walsworth Yearbooks Blog
feeds.description: Walsworth has been an innovative printer of scholastic yearbooks for more than 60 years. Walsworth Yearbooks is among the top four yearbook printers and is the only American- and family-owned publisher of yearbooks. News, creative ideas, staff fun... you can read it all and more in the weekly updates from the Walsworth Yearbooks Blog.

feeds.title: TreeRing Blog
feeds.description: We at TreeRing, capture students memories in a yearbook that not only reflects the school, but makes each student the star of their own book. Sign up to our Treering yearbook blog to receive regular updates on tips, trick and how-to's.

feeds.title: YearbookLife Blog
feeds.description: At YearbookLife we offer yearbook publishing and printing services, including elementary school yearbooks, middle school yearbooks, high school yearbooks, and more. Follow for Hints + tips for creating, marketing, and selling your yearbook.

feeds.title: Yearbook Machine Blog
feeds.description: Yearbook Machine is an easy-to-use online yearbook creation system that allows students and other groups to make high quality printed yearbooks and school leavers books.

feeds.title: Yearbook Discoveries Blog
feeds.description: Herff Jones Yearbook Discoveries is the leading yearbook publisher offering yearbook publishing ideas and yearbooks tips for yearbook staff and students.

feeds.title: SPC Yearbooks Blog
feeds.description: Discover all the yearbook guides, hint, and tips you need to create an amazing and unique yearbook design. The very best yearbook ideas to help you make this yearbook project the best ever.

feeds.title: School Annual
feeds.description: We create affordable high school, middle school or elementary school yearbooks using our online creation software. Low cost yearbooks are our specialty. We promise to make your experience with School Annual easy, fun and affordable.

feeds.title: Entourage Yearbooks
feeds.description: Entourage provides the most advanced service to create quality yearbooks and great prices. Design and order yearbooks for middle school, high school, college, and beyond! Let Entourage Yearbooks, a premier yearbook company, help you preserve memories that will last a lifetime.
